_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 14: 2025-06-06 to 2025-06-17. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that this time last year the Lord began telling him Adam's lease is coming up, and to look from Rosh Hashanah in September as when the lease comes up.
mentions.quote: the Adam's lease is coming up. This time last year he started talking
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation or a comparable transition beginning after Rosh Hashanah 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, which the four year reprieve explains in advance.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows what is coming in the fall of next year and that the birthing pains were shown to him as over the top, beyond ordinary labour pains.
mentions.quote: what's coming is the going in the fall of next year
mentions.falsify_match: A marked intensification of world events in autumn 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He describes chariots of fire lined up in heaven with packages on the back, waiting for a massive tidal wave, a tsunami of the glory of the Lord coming on the earth.
mentions.quote: A massive tsunami wave of the glory of the Lord was was coming
mentions.falsify_match: A global revival on the scale the image implies.

mentions.claim_text: He acknowledges the words come across heavy and sound like doom and gloom, says he delivers them in obedience, and that afterwards the Lord tells him to say something encouraging.
mentions.quote: it's not doom and gloom for the body of Christ
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of his own delivery.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him a divided state, half red and half blue, and that the governor race matters because he saw Governor Stitt brought down and a new Democratic figure trying to come in.
mentions.quote: I saw Governor Stitz being brought down and a new Democratic person
mentions.falsify_match: A Democrat winning the Oklahoma governorship in 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says to start praying now about 2026 because great distractions are coming, and describes California completely on fire with rioting and escalation in Seattle and Oregon, with the Lord again raising Timothy McVeigh.
mentions.quote: I saw a a California completely on fire with rioting
mentions.falsify_match: Major riots across California and the Pacific Northwest in 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking is coming and that the way people live and manoeuvre is bringing forth the beast system, and that there will be a lot of change in the blue and red states and within government politics in 2026.
mentions.quote: see a lot of change in the blue states and the red states
mentions.falsify_match: Significant partisan realignment across states during 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a continual escalation in Israel, and recalls that back around November he saw Jewish people celebrating in the streets.
mentions.quote: I saw a a continual escalation in Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Continued escalation in Israel and a moment of public celebration there.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying do not be hasty, watch and pay attention, and describes being asked to intercede on behalf of the Jewish people after what Hamas did in October.
mentions.quote: Don't be hasty. Watch. Pay attention
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction to wait rather than a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says his words will prove accurate if given time, citing the Asian man he said would rise, a Chinese-like man who would be like a pope in the Asian culture bringing a stirring there.
mentions.quote: they will prove to be accurate. Give him time. Just like the Asian man
mentions.falsify_match: An Asian religious leader of papal stature emerging.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know what he is seeing but sees an Asian man rising in Asia who will be part of the Catholic Church like a pope, trying to bring a revival.
mentions.quote: I see an Asian man. He's rising up in Asia
mentions.falsify_match: An Asian cardinal or figure rising to papal prominence.

mentions.claim_text: He counts the summer months June, July, August, September and October, then describes something coming down out of the sky into the Vatican and hitting the courtyard where the pope is announced.
mentions.quote: a route coming up out of the from the sky going down into the Vatican
mentions.falsify_match: A strike or crash into St Peter's Square.

mentions.claim_text: He describes an army inside the country, men rising up as cells of people in ten major cities and things on fire, and says he told them about the vans and the trucks back in January.
mentions.quote: like sales of people in 10 major cities. Very serious stuff
mentions.falsify_match: Coordinated attacks or unrest across ten American cities.

mentions.claim_text: Healing prayer calling the incurables cured, from a hangnail to what doctors call incurable, and saying he sees healings taking place right now.
mentions.quote: we call the incurables cured. We call the healings healed
mentions.falsify_match: A documented remission of a condition medicine calls incurable.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord circled the month of September with a cloud on it, and that he had said there was dust on it.
mentions.quote: circled the month of September and I told you it with a cloud on that
mentions.falsify_match: A September 2025 event involving dust or smoke, an explosion or a collapse.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is more to pray and he has nowhere else to go and wants to work, then prays over the nation and over the Fourth of July.
mentions.quote: We pray over our nation over the Fourth of July
mentions.falsify_match: An incident on 4 July 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the protection of Trump's towers and hotels and everyone in them over the Fourth of July, with a covering called from the 14th all the way to the 4th.
mentions.quote: for the protection of his towers. We thank you, Lord, for his hotels
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on a Trump property in that three week window.

mentions.claim_text: He invites others watching to say what they see, noting it is not all about him, and turns to requests for unsaved loved ones.
mentions.quote: Does anybody have a anything else they see? It's not all about me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He pushes back on King James only readers, saying if you do not understand it then it is not getting inside you and not changing you, and that the devourer is coming.
mentions.quote: If you're not getting it inside of you, it's not changing you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have a lot to do and a short time to do it, quoting Smokey and the Bandit, then asks viewers to subscribe.
mentions.quote: We have a lot to do and a short time to do it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer from Saturday through the Fourth of July and up to the 6th, a hedge over the president and his grandchildren, and says he saw the face of his eighteen year old granddaughter Kai specifically.
mentions.quote: I saw her face specifically. Her name is Kai. To pray over this young girl
mentions.falsify_match: Harm coming to Kai Trump in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Naming a specific person makes this unusually checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He lifts up Mel Gibson again, saying God's hand is on the man and referring to how loudly the Lord spoke to him about it.
mentions.quote: We lift up Mel Gibson before you again today
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession for a named person with no stated outcome.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer covering the nation, the president, the Fourth of July and the 14th, that no weapon formed prosper against the nation or Israel, and for the peace of Jerusalem.
mentions.quote: We cover our Fourth of July. We cover the 14th
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says a computer is becoming the Einstein, tied to the hydrogen collider and the God particle at CERN, and that technological advancements beyond wildest expectations are coming in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: we have a computer being the Einstein
mentions.falsify_match: An AI system credited with a physics breakthrough at Einstein's level.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the weeks going out, this week and the next two, with the Fourth of July coming right behind them in the fourth week.
mentions.quote: I see the weeks going out. I see the weeks
mentions.falsify_match: Events across those four weeks culminating around 4 July.

mentions.claim_text: He says he just heard the Lord call this a prayer assignment running until after the Fourth of July, seeing many plots and plans, and that protection must be prayed over the nation from now until then.
mentions.quote: I see many pots and many plans going until after the 4th of July
mentions.falsify_match: Plots surfacing or attacks occurring before 4 July 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He declares it done, that they have won and have the victory, and that everything is going to be all right.
mentions.quote: We've got the victory. Everything is going to be all right
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: victory declared before any outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says that while praying he could see there was something inside a box car, and casts the care of it onto the Lord who is working through them.
mentions.quote: I could see there's something in that box car
mentions.falsify_match: A rail freight incident, which would also bear on the Timothy McVeigh word.

mentions.claim_text: He declares deliverance over viewers' houses from demonic strongholds including alcoholism, pornography and lust.
mentions.quote: You're delivered from that lust in Jesus name
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private deliverance over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says the rat in the White House is now visible, that he gave a word about Elon Musk on 30 October calling him a rat, and that he took a lot of persecution for it.
mentions.quote: I gave you all word about Elon Musk and I said he is a rat
mentions.falsify_match: The 30 October 2024 statement can be located in the corpus, and Musk's June 2025 break with Trump would then match it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement is found at that date.

mentions.claim_text: He points to the division and strife now taking place in the White House, says he told them there was a rat there, and that he has been warning about it since January.
mentions.quote: there was a white a rat in the White House. Did I not?
mentions.falsify_match: A public falling out inside the administration, which the Musk break supplies.
mentions.falsify_miss: The prior warnings cannot be located.
